subject.title: [Bug]: Regression: User-configured heartbeat prompt no longer respected

question: Should maintainers refresh the open conflicting fork PR for this heartbeat prompt regression, or close that route and sponsor a narrow same-repo replacement fix?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and still present in the latest release, but the only open closing-syntax fix is an unproven conflicting fork PR and the issue is already marked no-new-fix-pr, so automation should not start a competing repair path without maintainer ownership.

options.title: Sponsor Same-Repo Repair
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork path and create one focused same-repo fix with prompt-boundary regression coverage.

options.title: Refresh Fork PR
options.body: Ask the fork PR author or a maintainer to rebase it, add real behavior proof, and expand coverage for the transcript-marker boundary before review.

options.title: Pause For Owner Triage
options.body: Keep the issue open without a new repair until a heartbeat prompt owner chooses the exact fix scope.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Same-Repo Repair
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork path and create one focused same-repo fix with prompt-boundary regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is tied to the path-hint introduction and the first focused same-repo fix attempt for this regression.
